build_TransformerBlock: build a TransformerBlock module for point cloud transformer convolution with position and attention MLPs
create_TransitionDown: create a TransitionDown module to sample and downsample point cloud features using FPS and max pooling
create_MLP: create an MLP sequential module with configurable channels and optional batch normalization layers
create_TransitionUp: create a TransitionUp module to interpolate low-res features back to higher resolution point clouds
create_Attention: create a multi-head Attention module with query key value projections and optional masking support
